auth_default: on (JWT + Postgres password) BUT shipped with placeholder secrets that operators often leave

active_probe.false_positive_check: must include openguardrails string in body, not just 200 OK

default_creds_patterns.context: .env.example SUPER_ADMIN defaults -- if operator left as-is, super-admin login is the literal placeholder
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=your_password -- direct DB takeover via port 54321 if unchanged and exposed
GUARDRAILS_MODEL_API_KEY=EMPTY -- intended for self-hosted vLLM, but if operator points to OpenAI-compatible upstream and leaves EMPTY, no upstream auth

misconfig_patterns: POSTGRES_PORT=54321 exposed to 0.0.0.0 -- DB reachable from internet when host has no firewall
vLLM model API on 58002/58004 reachable without auth (designed for private VPC, often deployed flat)
Frontend served on /platform/ subpath -- enumeration tell
vulnerabilities: No published CVEs as of 2026-06-07; default-creds pattern is the de facto exposure

cve_catalog_2026_06_07.note: Pre-CVE project. Risk lives in default-cred replication, not in disclosed bugs.

dork_population_substitution_risk: HIGH. Dork 'http.html:OpenGuardrails' selects operators who deployed it AND exposed the frontend publicly -- already a self-selected subpopulation. A second-order signal (Postgres :54321 + redis-7-alpine container + supervisord process) selects operators who deployed via the stock docker-compose, which is a different subset (the lazy-deploy population). Use both axes; do not assume one represents the other.
lane_d_role: Hybrid: ships as a library (in-process scan calls) AND as a self-hosted platform with admin UI. Operators choose. The platform-mode deployment is the OSINT-visible variant.
